chunks: I wrote to him: If a man’s hands or body are touched by the garment of the deceased which is next to his skin before he is given ghusl, is washing his hands or body obligatory upon him?
So he wrote in reply: “If the body of the deceased touches your hand before he is given ghusl, then ghusl becomes obligatory upon you.”

key_terms.الْغُسْلُ: ritual bath required in this case

ai.seo_question: Does touching a deceased body before it is washed require ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal ruling concerning contact with a deceased body before it has been given ghusl. It indicates that direct contact with the corpse before its ritual washing entails the obligation of ghusl, clarifying a matter of ritual purity in funerary rulings.
